newsitem.title: FINLAND: Finnish paper industry output turns higher in Sept.
newsitem.headline: Finnish paper industry output turns higher in Sept.

text.p: Finnish forest industry output rose 3.1 percent year-on-year in September -- the first month of growth since August 1995, Statistics Finland (SF) said on Friday.
In January-September, the year-on-year fall in the wood and paper industry's production volume was 6.8 percent, an SF official said by telephone. In August, the sector's output fell 3.7 percent.
"Production of pulp, paper and paper products increased 2.6 percent and mechanical forest industry (production rose) 4.1 percent," SF said in a statement referring to September.
It said Finnish overall industrial production rose 6.1 percent year-on-year in September -- the biggest increase for more than a year.
In August, industrial production increased 1.8 percent.
Energy sector output rose 17.2 percent year-on-year in September after an 11.8 percent increase in August.
Metal, engineering and electrotechnical industry production increased 6.2 percent in September after a 1.9 percent rise in August, SF said.
